patches.symptom: POST /api/rdp-token answers 401 for the current run's dashboard token while the refresh-aware routes accept the same token; and a previous run's token stays mintable for the life of the process
patches.rootCause: the route compared the bearer against $script:Token, read once at boot (payloads/ghrdp-server.ps1), while main.yml writes dash-token.txt/config.json.dashToken long after the GHRDP-Server task is kicked
patches.failingReproduction: lab run 39929404780 job 120333833464 (application-origin): ourBearer=401, anonymous=401, forged=401, diag expectedLen=0 publishedLen=32, refresh-aware probe REFRESH_AWARE_CURRENT
patches.targetedRegression: node --test tests/p001-p002-ticket-and-version-identity.test.js (3 tests at this commit, 5 after P002)
negativeCases: empty snapshot and no current token -> 401
patches.windowsEvidence: run 39937351659: baseline refused the current token and minted a superseded one; candidate accepted the current and refused the superseded
patches.limitations: no rotation grace window (none documented); the boot snapshot remains the fallback when no current token can be read; a 200 mint from a real tailnet peer is still unproven

patches.symptom: GET /api/version answers sha="dev" while config.json carries the exact build identity
patches.rootCause: the route's config fallback read the key 'commit'; main.yml writes 'buildSha', and the Scheduled-Task server inherits no GHRDP_BUILD_SHA/GITHUB_SHA
patches.failingReproduction: lab run 39929404780: VERSION_UNREACHABLE/VERSION_STAMP_ABSENT; source-read of /api/version shows the 'commit' fallback
negativeCases: config.json without buildSha/gitCommit/sourceSha still answers dev
an empty buildSha is not accepted as identity
patches.windowsEvidence: run 39937351659: candidate /api/version sha=978a8375… 40-hex; the no-identity phase still answers dev
patches.limitations: reports the identity the workflow wrote; it cannot detect a config.json written by a different run (that is the run-descriptor's job)

patches.symptom: /api/purge-stale-creds (a credential-DELETING command route) refused the current run's dashboard token and accepted a superseded one
patches.rootCause: identical to P001: the gate compared the bearer with the boot snapshot only (-not $Token -or length -ne ...)
patches.failingReproduction: source read at the base and at the live run's SHA 15e15ab8 (line 8226); measured in run 39937351659 on the baseline arm
patches.windowsEvidence: run 39937351659: purge_current accepted / purge_superseded refused on the candidate; the inverse on the baseline
patches.limitations: the returned command is never executed by the lab; the route has no tailnet-source check, which is pre-existing behaviour
